## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --all` pass.
- [ ] Changes people will notice are in `CHANGELOG.md`, under "Unreleased".
- [ ] The README and the settings template (`core/src/config/default.toml`) are up to date.
- [ ] Code, comments and the title are in English; the title is in the imperative mood ("Add ...", not "Added ...").
